_doc: The bugs the Vuln jobs look for, and the known bugs set apart. The only file to edit; readable at /html/publisher/bugs.html (Results: ❔ → Bugs reference).

Targets, one entry per vendor preset of VulnA ("<vendor>:<preset>"): cve: the CVE left in the preset (tlspuffin puffin-build/vendors/wolfssl/builder.cmake: the declared vulnerabilities minus the preset's fixes); kind: how the fuzzer records it, crash (match: a function among the top 3 frames of the fuzzer's backtrace or of the replay's stack) or claim (match: the security violation message); note: where the rule comes from.

An objective matching the target ends the experiment (PR_vulnerabilities.sh, monitor TargetedObjectiveFound) and makes the 🎯 of the pages. A preset not listed (VulnB) ends on its first objective that is not set apart, as before.

_not_targeted: claims of the security oracle that are a known CVE of the old library versions, never a target: on the library (library) below the version (below) they do not end an experiment and are shown as ⦸ on the pages; anywhere else the claim is a bug like any other (⚠ unexpected, 🚨 new).

New bugs (🚨): in a configuration with a target (BUF, SKIP…), a bug its earlier tasks never had; in a plain version (no target, e.g. Perf's wolfSSL 5.8.0), a bug that is none of the CVEs tlspuffin declares for that build (its vendorinfo: known minus fixed vulnerabilities, recorded as cli.vulnerabilities) with a signature here, which is then shown as 📋 known. A CVE's signature: kind/match in _cves, else those of the target naming it, else the claim of _not_targeted naming it (objectives_page/cve_signatures.jq); a CVE without one cannot be recognised: give it kind and match in _cves.

Taken into account by: new tasks (scripts/build.sh writes them into the job scripts, copied to /srv/puffin-bench/data/html/jobsscripts/tlspuffin/), and the objectives reports written from then on (objectives_report.sh).

wolfssl:wolfssl540-buf.note: stack-buffer-overflow in RefineSuites; 616 objectives of 7 VulnA tasks (2026-10-07)

wolfssl:wolfssl530-cdos.note: crash in wolfSSL_Free < AddSessionToCache; depends on the fuzzer's session cache: replays do not reproduce it, the fuzzer's backtrace is the evidence

wolfssl:wolfssl540-heap.note: heap-buffer-overflow in AddPacketInfo (with ASan); 7 VulnA tasks

wolfssl:wolfssl510-skip.note: the oracle's claim of an authentication bypass; 7 VulnA tasks

_cves._doc: The CVEs the Vuln jobs are built around (reference table of the tlspuffin evaluation): alias, CVSS, type, first found by tlspuffin (✓/✗), version, TLS version, as given there. Shown on the Bugs reference page. Optional kind and match (as for a target): how to recognise the CVE when no target names it.

Negotiated cipher is not in agent's conf.note: tlspuffin e6bbd77b (2026-03): the oracle of CVE-2024-5814, which every wolfSSL < 5.7.2 has; set apart only there: on any other library or version this claim is a bug
